periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the eye patches are oriented at approximately 40-50 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, converging towards the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid teardrop geometry with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 1.4:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering with the inferior boundary extending medially towards the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The lateral dark band at the shoulders/flanks occupies approximately 25-30% of the visible vertical torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The gap between the medial boundaries of the ears is approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae exhibit smooth, semicircular convexity with no visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-brown exogenous staining is present on the ventral fur, most concentrated in the abdominal and inguinal regions.
